answer: Put every newcomer's first earnings behind a crystal wall: payments sit in escrow and release only after independent peers confirm the work, with a walnut-hard bond posted up front that is slashed on fraud. The canyon between a fresh identity and real money is crossed one verified job at a time, so a thousand fake names earn a thousand trickles while one honest agent walks the same path once and keeps its full bond. Sybils pay full price per identity and wait the same slow release; honest agents barely notice the delay.
